summary: Full resolution of all residual cleanup findings (F05-01 through F05-04) verified by independent audit (Agent E: PASS), 100% green full backend suite (154/154 PASS), real Google Drive read-only WinFsp mount on X: (MOUNTED), end-to-end browser playback in Chrome with 1080p frame decoding and 3 UI seeks (including 94% near-end seek), and GPU CUDA inference of fine-tuned Qwen3-4B + Phase 23 LoRA via BitsAndBytes 4-bit NF4.

F05-01_disposalGateResetRace.finding: Resetting disposalGate in dispatchLateDisposal under saturation created a TOCTOU race where worker and caller could drop disposal duty, leaking unclosed channels.
F05-01_disposalGateResetRace.resolution: Replaced boolean gate with monotonic 6-state AtomicInteger transition machine (DISPOSAL_UNCLAIMED -> CALLER_DISPATCHING -> DISPATCH_ACCEPTED | DISPATCH_FAILED -> WORKER_CLAIMED | RETAINED). Caller fallback CAS and worker outer finally block guarantee no handle abandonment.

F05-02_unreservedPendingAccounting.finding: Unreserved executeOpen and dispatchLateDisposal retained failed cleanups without charging pending permit; retry could decrement pending below zero (-1) or admit beyond capacity.
F05-02_unreservedPendingAccounting.resolution: Encapsulated volatile boolean chargesPending in RetainedFailedCleanup. submitRetryTask dynamically acquires pending permit bounded by total < cleanupQueueCapacity. decrementPendingAndCheckShutdown clamped at 0.

F05-03_channelRetryCloseLogic.finding: DriveSeekableByteChannel.retryClose() checked reservation failed state only, falsely reporting true if delegate failed physical close without reservation tracking.
F05-03_channelRetryCloseLogic.resolution: retryClose() directly verifies ioExecutor.hasFailedCleanup(delegate) before checking delegateClosed flag, ensuring truthful retry dispatch.

F05-04_concurrencyInvariants.finding: Concurrency invariants: active >= 0, pending >= 0, active + pending <= cleanupQueueCapacity, zero caller-thread native close on timeout/shutdown.
F05-04_concurrencyInvariants.resolution: Verified composite atomic lifecycle state machine, CAS permit reservation loops, non-blocking caller returns, and deduplicated retries via markInFlight().
F05-04_concurrencyInvariants.tests: Full Backend Suite (154/154 PASS), Drive Regression Suite (111/111 PASS)

F05-05_realDrivePlayback.finding: Verification of real Google Drive WAN playback required on remote cinema-drive folder 1Ypyq-KuQKEhHrWuxtrrR8Y4G7DwbeyZQ with videoplayback.mp4 (29,209,556 bytes).
F05-05_realDrivePlayback.resolution: Mounted read-only to X: using rclone and WinFsp (PID 17024, MOUNTED). Executed real_drive_playback.cjs: HEAD 200, Range 206 byte-for-byte verified, decoded frames 35/38/41, 3 seeks at 25%, 60%, 94%, pause/resume, and 44px mobile touch controls.

F05-06_qwenFineTunedServing.finding: Integration and proof of fine-tuned Qwen model (Qwen3-4B + Phase 23 LoRA) on GPU/CPU without mock fallback.
F05-06_qwenFineTunedServing.resolution: Loaded Qwen/Qwen3-4B base model and ai/models/qwen3-4b-phase23-lora on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU using BitsAndBytes NF4 4-bit quantization in dippie-qwen conda environment. Verified live intent generation.
